title: Graphene field-effect transistor based multiplexed sensing platform for simultaneous detection of multiple Alzheimer's disease biomarkers
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23937-23944
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07384G, Paper
Open Access

Biyu Guo, Jiangyang Wang, Feige Lou, Baowei Yuan, Zhibo Chen, Chengjie Tang, Weiao Chen, Fangxuan Yi, Jingjing Jiang, Guangxi Hu, Chunxiao Cong, Ye Lu
A GFET-based multiplexed sensor confines aptamer/probe chemistry via hydrophobic HMDS patterning, enabling dual Alzheimer's biomarker detection (hsa-miR-125b and Aβ42) from one droplet with signatures distinguishable down to 1 fM.
